newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds rise gently, positive outlook.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds rise gently, positive outlook.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Monday as trade got off to a slow start in what many expected to be another week of strong performance.
"The market is quiet with little trade but it is firm," said a trader at a local brokerage house.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/8 at 92-3/4, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was $0.20 higher at 115.30.

"The firmer market should also be helped by the confirmation from the government that it is negotiating an Extended Fund Facility with the IMF (International Monetary Fund)," said analysts at consultants C&E in an investor note.
The government starts Monday negotiations with the IMF over an Extended Fund Facility which will last until 2000.
